concurrency_scope: Memoria first, then raw_context; two isolated histories, questions serial within history
baseline: Full visible conversation before question; drop oldest whole turns only if byte/window budget exceeded. Record every truncation.
memoria: Literal attributed source units -> production native formation/independent review/consolidation -> Kernel.answer with unchanged 8000-character evidence budget; not personal Claim/View.
judge: Independent binary LLM with frozen adapted permissive rubric; no arm label or evidence override. Gold used only after answering.
failure_policy: Planned IDs stay in denominator; unknown judge coverage and answer errors are separate. No filtered-accuracy promotion.
accounting: Every formation, consolidation, Reader, support, repair and grading call. Shared ingestion once per visible-history hash. Missing usage stays unknown; retained upper reservation is not an invoice.
resume: Not implemented. Keep checkpoints, isolated databases and append-only calls. New execution is a new charged run.
interpretation_limits: Small balanced diagnostic subset, not representative whole-corpus accuracy or unseen generalization.
Compare paired parent predictions on exactly the same IDs; parent cached answers are historical, not newly charged requests.
External source route; personal Claim/View/Dense benefit is not established.
Prior full result remains immutable; do not replace it with this subset or run full without user approval.
billing_policy: Two consecutive insufficient-balance responses open a global circuit; retain every planned ID as not_run. No automatic top-up or retry.
authorization: 2026-10-23 user authorized small real-model tests only; no new full evaluation

sampling.method: first two histories; four uniformly sampled questions per category per history; no answer/gold/failure filters
